day4_reproduction.method: 5-fold GroupKFold, groups = first_author_key (fallback work_key), pooled out-of-fold predictions; default HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42) fit on log1p(ratio), predictions inverted with expm1; all 75 feature columns.

variance_breakdown.method: 5-fold GroupKFold, groups = first_author_key (fallback work_key), pooled out-of-fold predictions; metrics on the Day 4 leader's out-of-fold ratio-scale predictions.

top_1pct_largest_ratio.method: rows selected by largest observed ratio, ceil(0.01*n) = 674 rows.

r2_excluding_ratio_gt_2.method: R-squared recomputed on the 67170 rows with ratio <= 2.0, same OOF predictions.

noise_ceiling.method: src.models.noise_ceiling: ratio_noise_variance/share_noise_variance from k=n_read, n=n_read+n_want (work_ratios.parquet), then r2_ceiling = 1 - mean(noise_var)/var(target).

share_model.method: 5-fold GroupKFold, groups = first_author_key (fallback work_key), pooled out-of-fold predictions; default HistGradientBoostingRegressor(random_state=42) fit on raw share.

r2_to_ceiling_ratio.method: achieved R-squared (out-of-fold) divided by the Part A noise ceiling, same target.

feature_strength_check.method: 5-fold GroupKFold, groups = first_author_key (fallback work_key), pooled out-of-fold predictions; default HistGB fit on log1p(ratio), expm1 inverted; reduced model uses only log1p_n_want, log1p_n_reading, shelf_age_days.
